description: MainActivity.kt is an Android activity written in Kotlin that manages the UI for a Tic Tac Toe game. It handles view binding, user interactions, game state persistence, and rendering the game grid and status messages. It interacts with core game logic and data models to facilitate the game flow.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity that connects UI elements with game logic for a Tic Tac Toe game. Handles state persistence, user input, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, restores previous game state if available, and sets up click listeners.

methods.name: restoreFromBundle
methods.description: Restores game state from a saved Bundle, reconstructing the board and game status.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Serializes current game state into a Bundle to preserve across configuration changes.

methods.name: wireCellClicks
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to each cell button.

methods.name: onCellClicked
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a cell, attempts to make a move if valid.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to the initial state and clears UI entries.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on the current game state, including the grid and status messages.
